Evidence Requested: Export of IAM users, roles, attached/inline policies and privileged access assignments
Validation Notes: Redact account identifiers where needed; assess effective permissions in context.

Evidence Requested: MFA enforcement and privileged role-assumption configuration for human administrators
Validation Notes: Policy text alone is insufficient; confirm technical enforcement and scope.

Evidence Requested: Inventory of public endpoints, VPCs, subnets, route tables and security-group ingress/egress
Validation Notes: Compare effective connectivity with approved business data flows.

Evidence Requested: CloudTrail trail/event data-store status, account/region scope, event selectors and destination settings
Validation Notes: Confirm scope is appropriate for the organization's environment and obligations.

Evidence Requested: Log destination access policy, retention settings, encryption and log validation configuration where used
Validation Notes: Identify principals able to alter or delete records.

Evidence Requested: Selected security alarms, notification destinations, test results and response tickets
Validation Notes: Verify alert delivery, accountable owner and documented response.

Evidence Requested: AWS Config recorder status, supported resource coverage, rules and compliance history
Validation Notes: Document unsupported resources, excluded regions and approved exceptions.

Evidence Requested: Sample infrastructure-as-code changes, peer approvals, deployment logs and change tickets
Validation Notes: Trace change from request to implementation and validation.

Evidence Requested: Secret-scanning report, credential inventory metadata and rotation evidence without secret values
Validation Notes: Never commit live secrets or tokens to the public repository.

Evidence Requested: Critical asset backup coverage, protection settings and latest restore-test evidence
Validation Notes: Compare actual restore results to approved RTO/RPO.

Evidence Requested: Security findings register, risk exceptions, accountable owners, due dates and closure evidence
Validation Notes: Check escalation of overdue critical/high items and documented risk acceptance.

Evidence Requested: Approved architecture, asset inventory, data classification and shared-responsibility allocation
Validation Notes: Confirm scope, business criticality and control ownership before testing.
